Inglewood, California
  October 8, 2019

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, October 8, 2019, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
Mayor Butts called the City Council into session for Closed Session at the hour of
1:01 p.m.

The Acting City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor Butts, Council Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.

City officials and personnel present for Closed Session were as follows:

  Aisha Thompson  Acting City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney
  Cheryl Moore  Management Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor
Butts inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City
Council on the Closed Session Item.

There was no response.

Mayor Butts recessed the City Council at the hour of 1:02 p.m. for Closed Session
Item No. CS-1 – CS-3.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called
the City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing
Authority, and Joint Powers Authority, at the hour of 2:01 p.m.
The City Clerk/ Successor Agency Secretary/ Housing Authority Secretary/Joint
Powers Authority Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing
  Authority Chairman/ Joint Powers Authority
  Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor
  Agency  Members/Housing  Authority
  Members/Joint Powers Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Joint Powers Authority officials and
personnel present were as follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Joint
Powers Authority.

  1
 October 8, 2019

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts
  inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City
  Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Joint Powers Authority on any
  item on the Agenda.

  There was no response.

 180  COMMENDATION – HONORING BRYANT’S INGLEWOOD TOWING
  SERVICE. The Inglewood City Council presented Mr. Kirk Bryant with a
  commendation honoring their dedicated service to the City of Inglewood, as a
  community partner.

  Chief Fronterotta, thanked Mr. Bryant for his support to the Inglewood Police
  Department and presented Mr. Kirk Bryant with a commendation for his service.

  Kirk Bryant, thanked the City Council, and the Inglewood Police Department for
  trusting his business to do service for the City of Inglewood. He stated it has
  been a pleasure.

 180  COMMENDATION – HONORING THE INGLEWOOD BLACKHAWKS.
  The Inglewood City Council presented the Inglewood Blackhawks football team
  with a commendation recognizing their undefeated season and championship win.
  Tony and Tasha Reid thanked the City Council for always supporting the team,
  and presented Mayor Butts, and Council Member Padilla with championship rings
  for their support to their organization.

 142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council
  Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Morales and
  seconded by Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority
  Member Dotson that the demands presented to the City Council/Successor
  Agency/Housing Authority dated, October 3, 2019, in the amount of
  $1,715,183.96, are hereby allowed, and the City Clerk/Successor Agency
  Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to certify upon said
  registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by the
  following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority
  Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor/Successor
  Agency Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  MINUTES. It was moved by Council Member Morales and seconded by Council
  Member Dotson that the Minutes for the City Council Meetings held on
  September 10, 2019, September 11, 2019 (Special), and September 17, 2019, be
  approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

301  PUBLIC HEARING SET – CONSIDER ZONING CODE AMENDMENT
  2019-001 (ZCA-2019-0001) TO CHAPTER 12 OF THE INGLEWOOD
  MUNICIPAL CODE. Staff report dated October 8, 2019, was presented
  requesting a public hearing be set to consider Zoning Code Amendment 2019-001
  (ZCA-2019-0001) to Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code to allow
  towing service with ancillary vehicle storage and ancillary vehicle inspection in
  the C-S (Commercial Service) zone citywide.

  Mayor Butts set the Public Hearing for October 29, 2019, at the hour of 2:00 p.m.

168  ORDINANCE NO. 2020-01 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE INGLEWOOD

  2
 October 8, 2019

  MUNICIPAL CODE CHAPTER 3 (MOTOR VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC)
  ARTICLE 4 (PARKING METER REGULATIONS) SECTION 3-92(e)
  (PARKING METER RATES). Staff report dated October 8, 2019, was
  presented recommending adoption of Ordinance No. 2020-01 amending
  Inglewood Municipal Code Chapter 3 (Motor Vehicles and Traffic) Article 4
  (Parking Meter Regulations) Section 3-92(e) (Parking Meter Rates) to allow the
  City to collect or pass through convenience fees charged by third parties to
  process electronic payments to the person who chooses to make an electronic
  payment for a metered parking space.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member
  Franklin that further reading be waived. The motion was carried by the following
  roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

  Thereupon, It was moved by Mayor Butts, and seconded by Council Member
  Franklin that Ordinance No. 2020-01 entitled:

  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA
  AMENDING INGLEWOOD MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION 3-92 TO
  AUTHORIZE THE COLLECTION OF A CONVENIENCE FEE FOR
  ELECTRONIC PAYMENT MADE FOR A METERED PARKING
  SPACE

  be adopted. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

  Discussion Held; Direction Given to Staff.

 127.2  COUNCIL INITIATIVE

  Council Member Padilla:

  Initiative by Council Member Alex Padilla, District 2, requesting approval of City
  Sponsorship for the 7th Annual District 2 Christmas Toy and Canned Food Drive
  to be held on Saturday, December 14, 2019, from 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m., at the
  Community Center located at 1201 N. La Tijera Boulevard.

  3
 October 8, 2019

  It was moved by Mayor Butts, and seconded by Council Member Franklin that the
  City Council does hereby approve City Sponsorship. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

 219  ORAL REPORTS – CITY TREASURER. Wanda Brown, City Treasurer,
  gave a brief report on the bonds she purchased on behalf of the City, Economic
  Data Updates, debt in the United States, and the City Treasurer’s Academy
  Program.

 127.2  COUNCIL INITIATIVE

  Council Member Franklin:

  Initiative by Council Member Ralph L. Franklin, District 4, requesting approval
  of City Sponsorship for the 15th Annual District 4 Christmas Toy and Food Drive
  Celebration to be held on Thursday, December 12, 2019.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Mayor Butts that the
  City Council does hereby approve City Sponsorship. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Noes: None.

  PUBLIC REMARKS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present
  who wished to address the City Council on any matter connected with City
  business not elsewhere considered on the Agenda.

  Michael Benbow congratulated the Inglewood BlackHawks on their victory.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the
  meeting adjourned at the hour of 2:32 p.m.

  Approved this 29th day of October, 2019

  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
